name: Venera-4
about: Venera-4 (1967-058A, IKI/BABTS), launched 1967 Jun 12. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.716 au and aphelion 1.019 au against GCAT's 0.710 and 1.020
